title: 面包是怎么来的
subtitle: 一粒麦子的旅行
character: wearing a cream sweater, brown trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, warm gouache painting on textured paper, flat simple rounded shapes with clean outlines, wheat gold, crust brown and soft cream palette, visible brush texture

pages.zh:
面包店门口好香。
刚出炉的面包，
外面脆脆的，里面软软的。
它是从哪里来的呢？
我们从一粒麦子说起。
pages.scene: The little boy stands on tiptoe at a bakery counter looking at fresh loaves of bread, a warm glow from the shop.

pages.zh:
农民把麦粒种到地里。
下过几场雨，
田里长出一片绿油油的麦苗，
风一吹，
像绿色的波浪。
pages.scene: A wide field of green wheat seedlings on a cream background, with low hills behind and a few clouds. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
到了夏天，
麦子变成了金黄色。
沉甸甸的麦穗低下头，
收割机开进田里，
一趟一趟把麦子割下来。
pages.scene: A field of golden wheat on a cream background with one simple combine harvester cutting a lane through it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
麦穗里藏着麦粒。
把麦粒送进磨坊，
磨成细细的粉，
就是面粉。
面包的第一样材料，有了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one wheat ear at the left of a cream background, an arrow to a pile of grains in the middle, and another arrow to a mound of flour at the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
光有面粉还不行。
要加水，加一点盐，
还要加一样很小的东西——
「酵母」。
它是一种小小的活的菌。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four small piles on a cream background in a row: flour, a small bowl of water, a pinch of salt and a small spoon of yeast granules. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
酵母最爱吃面粉里的糖。
它一边吃，
一边放出很多小气泡。
气泡撑在面团里，
面团就慢慢鼓起来了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one ball of dough in cross-section on a cream background with many small round bubbles inside it and a few tiny yeast dots. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以揉好的面团，
要盖上布放一会儿。
过了一小时再看，
它变成了原来的两倍大，
胖乎乎的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two bowls side by side on a cream background: the left one with a small ball of dough, the right one with the same dough risen to twice the size. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把面团揉一揉，
把大气泡赶走，
再整成一个个小圆球，
排在烤盘上，
让它们再鼓一次。
pages.scene: Several rounded dough balls arranged in rows on a baking tray on a cream background, seen from above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
烤箱很热很热。
面团一进去，
里面的气泡受热变大，
面包就又长高了一截。
这一下叫「烤箱里的弹跳」。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one loaf inside an oven on a cream background, with an upward arrow beside it showing it rising as it bakes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
外面那一层，
在高温下变成金黄色，
又香又脆，
那是面粉和糖
在热里起了变化。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one baked loaf on a cream background shown in cross-section: a golden brown crust outside and a soft airy crumb inside. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
切开面包，
里面全是小小的洞。
每一个洞，
都是当初酵母
吐出来的一个小气泡。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one slice of bread shown large on a cream background, its crumb full of small round holes of different sizes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我掰下一块还热着的面包，
放进嘴里。
从一粒麦子，
到我手里的这一口，
走了好长好长的路。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a piece of fresh bread with both hands, taking a bite, a happy face, steam rising from the bread.
